limits: Raw allocation-event sums retain all overlapping observations; normalized non-alias sums exclude only source-supported same-thread adjacent Malloc/realloc(NULL) aliases, whose raw events/counts/bytes remain explicit. This is not a performance cost subtraction.

Return-side realloc events do not uniquely timestamp old-address release; other-thread address reuse can precede the combined old/new event. Exact peak/retained inference is unavailable once such an unresolved collision occurs.
Per-PID process Exit reclamation is separate from allocator Free. Public producer Exit semantics are known, private server heap-consumer semantics are not established.
Stack attribution is only observed frame-pointer/PC/LR symbols, not DWARF/inline unwinding; inclusive categories overlap and missing ancestry prevents absence proofs.
Only captured within-marker allocations are modeled, not entire/inherited process heap; unknown frees and nonzero realloc references remain separate counts.
